question: When can Energous terminate its strategic alliance agreement with Dialog for convenience?
search_query: terminate for convenience upon written notice
answer: Energous may terminate the Strategic Alliance Agreement for convenience any time after the third anniversary of the Effective Date, provided it gives Dialog at least one hundred and eighty (180) days prior written notice. [1]
